welcome.title: Hi, I'm Klop!
welcome.text: I'll show you how to track your cigarettes, see your progress and move forward at your own pace.

smokedLink.title: This is where you log
smokedLink.text: Tap “{{smokedLink}}”, under “{{validate}}”. It opens the counter for your total smoked today.

dailyTotal.title: Your daily total
dailyTotal.text: Adjust the number with + and −, then tap “{{save}}”. You log the total for the day, not just one new cigarette.

efforts.title: Your efforts show
efforts.text: See your cigarettes, the money you saved and your estimated life time gained. These results grow with every day you log.

periods.title: Watch your progress
periods.text: Pick day, week or month to follow your consumption. “{{period}}” also lets you choose your own dates.

habits.title: Understand your cravings
habits.text: Spot the moments and situations linked to the cravings you log. Day after day, you get to know your habits better.

plan.title: One step at a time
plan.text: Find your goal and the next milestones of your journey. “{{modifyPlan}}” lets you adjust your pace.

choice.title: You're in charge
choice.text: Quit completely, reduce gradually or set a free goal: pick what suits you. Your plan can always be changed.

finish.title: Your turn!
finish.text: This button saves your goal changes. The tour doesn't change anything in your current plan. Now let's head to your home screen.

widget.title: How to add it
widget.hint: The widget then shows your day, updated each time you confirm a day.
widget.step1: Press and hold the home screen
